memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: Present to the LORD a food offering consisting of a burnt offering of two young bulls, one ram and seven male lambs a year old, all without defect. With each bull offer a grain offering of three-tenths of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with oil; with the ram, two-tenths; and with each of the seven lambs, one-tenth. Include one male goat as a sin offering to make atonement for you. - Num 28:19-22 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Throughout the seven days of the festival, offerings were to be brought to the Lord, including a sin offering to make atonement. Even in a time of celebration and remembrance, atonement remained necessary. The joy of redemption did not cancel the ongoing need for cleansing from sin. The two belonged together.

This reveals a beautiful balance in Israel's worship. They celebrated God's saving power with gladness, yet they never presumed upon His grace. The sin offering during the feast kept them humble, reminding them that even a redeemed people continually needs God's mercy. Joy and humility walked together before the Lord.

We should hold this same balance. As those redeemed by Christ, we rejoice greatly in our salvation. Yet we never outgrow our need for grace or our dependence on the cleansing Christ provides. The Christian life is not proud self-sufficiency but glad, humble reliance on the Saviour who atoned for us.

The wonderful truth is that in Christ, atonement and celebration are perfectly joined. His one sacrifice is both the ground of our joy and the cleansing we continually rest in (Heb 9:14). We do not bring goats to make atonement; we rest in the atonement already made. Celebrate your redemption with joy, and never stop depending on the grace that flows from the cross.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Do you hold joy in salvation together with humble dependence on grace?
2. How does the sin offering during the feast keep worship humble?
3. What does it mean that atonement and celebration meet in Christ?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, thank You that in Christ my joy in salvation and my need for grace are perfectly joined. Help me celebrate my redemption with gladness while resting humbly in Your cleansing mercy. Amen.
